ex.s: The research, carried out by scientists at the Columbia Climate School and other institutions, found that if the city maintains past species patterns in new plantings, isoprene production in Manhattan in coming decades will go up by about 140%, and resulting summer ozone levels as much as 30%.
ex.t: 由哥伦比亚气候学院等机构的科学家进行的研究发现，如果该市在新种植中维持过去的物种格局，未来几十年曼哈顿的异戊二烯产量将上升约140%，由此导致的夏季臭氧水平将上升多达30%。

ex.s: Barcelona has put together a package of clean energy technologies to help public transportation go greener, while also doing its part to tackle climate change and aid Europe’s difficult shift to the privately owned electric vehicle market.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那整合了一系列清洁能源技术，帮助公共交通变得更环保，同时也为应对气候变化出力，并助力欧洲艰难地向私人电动汽车市场转型。

ex.s: Carbon removal is crucial for fighting climate change.
ex.t: 碳移除对于应对气候变化至关重要。

ex.s: To study climate patterns.
ex.t: 为了研究气候模式。

ex.s: So, as climate change and biodiversity loss threaten natural scents, many people may not even notice.
ex.t: 无论我们是否关注世界的"气味景观"，热浪和污染正在使其发生变化。

ex.s: Climate change is also quickening the loss of biodiversity, threatening to erase certain smells entirely.
ex.t: 当植物消失时，它们的气味变得更加难以产生。

ex.s: Even though we have other valuable things endangered by climate change, like food access, there is also an element of cultural identity, cultural survival, and history.
ex.t: 尽管我们还有其他因气候变化而受到威胁的宝贵事物，比如食物获取，但这里也有文化认同、文化存续和历史的元素。

ex.t: 雪因气候变暖而加剧。

ex.s: Habitat loss, pesticide use, and climate change have caused dramatic declines in pollinator populations over the past couple of decades, which has damaged the US agricultural economy.
ex.t: 栖息地的丧失、杀虫剂的使用和气候变化在过去几十年中导致传粉昆虫数量急剧下降，这损害了美国农业经济。

ex.s: China is a shining example for the global community to follow _________developing green industry to fight climate change.
ex.t: 中国是全球社会在（第__空）发展绿色产业应对气候变化方面值得效仿的典范。

ex.s: The inability to engage with longer-term causes and consequences leads to some of the world’s most serious problems: climate change, biodiversity collapse, and more.
ex.t: 无法关注长期的原因和后果导致了一些世界上最严重的问题：气候变化、生物多样性丧失等等。

ex.s: Climate change has been forgotten.
ex.t: 气候变化已经被遗忘。

ex.s: But Cobb and others ____38____ （be） now questioning that idea pushing conferences to provide more chances to participate remotely, and ____39____（change） their personal behavior to do their part in dealing with the climate change crisis.
ex.t: 但Cobb和其他人现在____38____ （be）开始质疑这种观点，推动会议提供更多远程参与的机会，并____39____（change）改变个人行为，为应对气候变化危机尽自己的一份力。

ex.s: On a website called No Fly Climate Sci, for example, _____40_____（rough） 200 academics - many of them climate scientists ____41____ （promise） to fly as little as possible since the effort started two years ago.
ex.t: 例如，在一个名为No Fly Climate Sci的网站上，（第40空，rough）200名学者——其中许多是气候科学家——自两年前该行动开始以来（第41空，promise）尽可能少飞。

ex.s: From 2000 to 2019, there were 7,348 major natural disasters around the world,____19____(result) in USD 2,970 billion in economic loss．Much of this increase can be due to climate change.
ex.t: 从2000年到2019年全球共发生7,348次重大自然灾害造成29,700亿美元的经济损失．这种增长很大程度上可能是由于气候变化造成的．

ex.s: A warmer climate.
ex.t: 更温暖的气候。

ex.s: By the end of the century，if not sooner，the world's oceans will be bluer and greener thanks to a warming climate，according to a new study.
ex.t: 一项新研究显示，到本世纪末（若非更早），由于气候变暖，世界海洋将变得更蓝更绿。

ex.s: Climate change will fuel the growth of phytoplankton in some areas，while reducing it in other spots，leading to changes in the ocean's appearance.
ex.t: 根据一项新的研究，如果不更快的话，到本世纪末，由于气候变暖，世界海洋将变得更蓝更绿。

ex.s: When these organisms die，they bury carbon in the deep ocean，an important process that helps to regulate the global climate.
ex.t: 当这些生物死亡时，它们把碳埋入深海，这一重要过程有助于调节全球气候。

ex.s: Stephanie Dutkiewicz，a scientist in MIT's Center for Global Change Science，built a climate model that projects changes to the oceans throughout the century.
ex.t: 麻省理工学院全球变化科学中心的科学家斯蒂芬妮·杜特凯维奇建立了一个气候模型，预测本世纪海洋的变化。

ex.t: 苏珊去年我去看望她时辞去了高薪工作，在社区做了一名志愿者。

ex.s: So even if emissions were to begin to decrease today, we would still face the challenge of adapting to climate change.
ex.t: 所以即使排放量从今天开始减少，我们仍将面临适应气候变化的挑战。

ex.s: Here I will stress some smarter and more creative examples of climate adaptation.
ex.t: 在这里我将强调一些更智能、更有创意的气候适应案例。

ex.s: When it comes to adaptation, it is important to understand that climate change is a process.
ex.t: 说到适应，重要的是要理解气候变化是一个过程。

ex.s: This is why, in part at least, the US National Climate Assessment says that: ＂There is no ‘one-size fits all’ adaptation.＂ Nevertheless, there are some actions that offer much and carry little risk or cost.
ex.t: 这就是为什么，至少部分地，美国《国家气候评估》说：“没有‘一刀切’的适应。”尽管如此，有些行动收益大、风险和成本却小。

ex.s: Climate change is a continuing process, so Norphel’s ice reserves will not last forever.
ex.t: 气候变化是一个持续的过程，所以诺费尔的冰储备不会永远持续下去。

ex.s: In Peru, local farmers around a mountain with a glacier that has already fallen victim to climate change have begun painting the entire mountain peak white in the hope that the added reflectiveness will restore the life-giving ice.
ex.t: 在秘鲁，一座山峰的冰川已成为气候变化的牺牲品，周围的当地农民开始把整个山顶漆成白色，希望增加的反射率能恢复那赋予生命的冰。

ex.s: Human beings will continue to adapt to the changing climate in both ordinary and astonishing ways.
ex.t: 人类将继续以普通和惊人的方式适应不断变化的气候。

ex.t: 全球变暖影响适应形式D. 适应气候变化具有挑战性

ex.s: Adapting to climate change.
ex.t: 适应气候变化。

ex.s: Though much of Western Australia is desert, its great size means that it has a diverse climate, flora and fauna.
ex.t: 虽然西澳大利亚的大部分地区是沙漠，但其巨大的面积意味着它拥有多样化的气候、动植物群。

ex.s: With its beautiful views, mild climate and friendly people, Vancouver is known as both a popular tourist attraction and a good place to live in.
ex.t: 温哥华以其美丽的景色、温和的气候和友好的人们而闻名，既是一个受欢迎的旅游景点，也是一个宜居之地。

ex.s: Experts say this bad weather has occurred due to climate change.
ex.t: 专家表示，这种恶劣天气是由气候变化造成的。

ex.s: But this unique and delicate place is now under threat from pollution and climate change.
ex.t: 但这个独特而微妙的地方现在正受到污染和气候变化的威胁。

ex.s: Gases and minerals, in the form of volcanic dust trapped in the ice, can tell us a lot about the history of our planet5s climate.
ex.t: 捕获在冰中的火山灰形式的气体和矿物质可以告诉我们许多有关地球气候历史的信息。

ex.s: Snow — already threatened by a warming climate — absorbs different chemicals from the atmosphere as temperatures rise, which changes its cold-clean scent.
ex.t: 雪——已受到气候变暖的威胁——随着气温升高会从大气中吸收不同的化学物质，从而改变它清冷洁净的气味。

ex.t: 人们还认为这些地方可以帮助减少洪水风险、从大气中去除碳、应对气候变化，以及改善当地居民的心理健康。
